QF.id: AIFM CIII Fee Structure and Fund Performance_14

question.text: An open-ended Cat III fund's HWM NAV/unit is INR 1,420. Current NAV/unit is INR 1,278. What is the current drawdown from HWM?

explanation.text: The Logic: Maximum drawdown is defined as a peak-to-trough decline quoted as a percentage of the peak value. Drawdown % = (Current − HWM)/HWM = (1278 − 1420)/1420 = −142/1420 = −10.00%. The Trap: -11.11% is the required gain from trough to HWM, not the current drawdown. -14.20% uses the wrong divisor. -9.00% is a rounding artefact. Note: The HWM is the threshold above which incentive fees may be charged; it does not by itself tell you the recovery percentage required from the trough.
